data.content_ref: inline:The problem specifies that the lease-mismatch code must be emitted BEFORE ANY provider call. SRC_002's proposed mutation inserts the catch-all exception handler inside routing logic, where the precondition fires during routing — a stage that may occur before the provider call regardless of whether the typed code is emitted. This does not exercise the critical temporal boundary (before vs. after the provider call) that the problem asks the forbidden case to protect. The mutation as described could silently pass the suite even if the exception handler fires DURING a provider call, because the suite only checks for the presence of the typed code, not its emission prior to any provider interaction.
